Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class AiSearchController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.AiSearchController
@Controller @RequestMapping("/research/ai-search") public class AiSearchController extends Object
Unified Thymeleaf controller for AI-Enhanced Search (Slice 40 merge).

Serves GET /research/ai-search — the single search page that retrieves articles via vector similarity and synthesizes them through multiple LLM models (Claude, GPT, Perplexity) for side-by-side comparison. Replaces the former separate Semantic Search and AI Search pages.

FREE-tier users see an upgrade banner instead of the search form. SUBSCRIBER-tier users who have exhausted their monthly query limit see a limit-reached warning. Each successful search increments the subscriber's monthly usage counter via UsageTrackingPort.

If AI synthesis fails, the controller falls back to vector-only results via ArticleSearchPort.findSimilar(String, int).

    • search

      @GetMapping public String search(@RequestParam(required=false) String q, @RequestParam(required=false) Integer topK, @RequestParam(required=false) List<String> models, Principal principal, org.springframework.ui.Model model)
      Renders the AI-enhanced search page.

      If the authenticated user is FREE tier, sets accessDenied=true and renders an upgrade banner. If the user is SUBSCRIBER tier, accepts an optional query parameter q and returns multi-model AI syntheses.

      Parameters:
      q - optional search query string
      topK - optional max articles to retrieve (default 10, max 50)
      principal - the authenticated user
      model - Thymeleaf model
      Returns:
      the "ai-search" view name
